C0463.title: Hong'an Police Arrest Man for Using Fake Transfer Records to Obtain Cash
C0463.summary: On January 7, 2025, Fang, a man from Huangpi District in Wuhan, used a foot therapy shop membership top-up and proxy transfer as a pretext, sending software-generated fake transfer screenshots to saleswoman Tang and obtaining RMB 12,000 in cash. Hong'an police arrested Fang on February 18, recovered the illegal proceeds, returned the money to the victim, and placed Fang under compulsory criminal measures.
